Algeria (DZ), issue #558, transcribed 2026-09-30 from RECHERCHE_558_ALGERIE.md (section 5). No mandated or suggested transmission channel is declared here because none was found: the issue #558 research pass searched the full text of seven finance laws (2022-2026), three consolidated 2026 tax codes (CPF, CIDTA, CTCA), the DGI's own official communique on the 2026 finance law, and the DGI's own internal search engine for 'facturation electronique', 'e-facture', 'clearance', 'signature electronique' and 'caisse enregistreuse' tied to any obligation, and found no occurrence of any of them describing something in force or formally announced with a date.

This directly contradicts a claim that existed in this product's own documentation before this research (documentation/docs/developer-guide/countries/algeria.md, a 'DGI e-Invoice System' with a clearance model and a mandatory electronic signature): that claim is a legacy note, never verified before this research pass, and is NOT confirmed by any primary source this pass reached. It is corrected, not repeated, by this PR's own documentation changes: see that file's own history.

Not a proof of absence: mfdgi.gov.dz serves its own list of regulatory texts through client-side JavaScript, which this research pass's automated tooling could not read (confirmed independently), so a text existing only there could have been missed; the site's TLS certificate is also invalid for a direct browser visit, forcing curl-based access for everything this pass did reach. No 2026-2027 mandatory e-invoicing rumor was found either, in the sources reached; the native contributor for issue #558, asked directly, answered on 2026-09-30 that there is 'nothing in reality about e-invoicing for now', naming only Jibayatic (the DGI's own tax-payment portal, SAP-based) as a digital platform already in use: for paying taxes, not for issuing e-invoices, and no one is forced to produce e-invoices through it today per that same answer. b2g-routing/ and reporting/ are left without a dz.json file for the identical reason: nothing found justifies either yet, the same posture this file's own PT sibling already documents for a different, but structurally similar, absence of evidence.
